title: File:Panoramica de Bossòst-2016.JPG
claims: The photograph is a daylight winter view of Bossòst along the Garonne: a stone embankment and rocky river channel in front, pollarded bare trees and a road behind, low-rise houses with slate roofs, a church spire at left and a sunlit mountain ridge above the village.

Commons titles the photograph Panoramica de Bossòst-2016.JPG; it shows the village and river environment, not the VDA aid station, bag-drop tent, timing mat, course marking, start arch, finish line or race-day crowd.
The author is Alberto-g-rovi; the file is licensed CC BY 3.0; the photograph was taken on 2016-01-17 at 17:45:38; the original is 4,288 x 2,848 pixels and 12,019,848 bytes.
The route page uses a 960 x 638 copy of 304,833 bytes without cropping or colour change and credits Alberto-g-rovi, CC BY 3.0, Wikimedia Commons; the resized copy keeps the same licence.
